# Hikari Knife

> > Premium Japanese-style kitchen knives crafted with Damascus steel, VG-10, and carbon steel for professional chefs and home cooks.

Hikari Knife specializes in high-quality Japanese kitchen knives featuring traditional craftsmanship and modern blade technology. The collection spans specialized knife types for every culinary task, from precision vegetable work to professional meat preparation, with options in Damascus, carbon, and stainless steel.

## Key Topics

- Damascus Steel
- VG-10 Steel
- Carbon Steel
- High-Carbon Stainless Steel
- Japanese Kitchen Knives
- Chef Knives (Gyuto)
- Santoku
- Kiritsuke
- Nakiri
- Professional Chef Knives
- Precision Cutting
- Rosewood Handles
- Pakkawood
- Walnut Handles
- Sushi & Sashimi Knives

## Chef & Multi-Purpose Knives

- [Chef Knives – Premium Japanese Blades for Everyday Cooking](https://hikariknife.com/collections/chef-knife): Collection of Gyuto and Damascus steel chef knives with VG-10 and carbon steel options
- [Santoku Knives – Multi-Purpose Blades for Everyday Cooking](https://hikariknife.com/collections/santoku-multi-purpose): Santoku multi-purpose knife collection for slicing, dicing, and chopping tasks
- [Kiritsuke Knives – Precision Blades for Versatile Use](https://hikariknife.com/collections/kiritsuke): Kiritsuke knife collection with VG-10 Damascus steel for precision cutting
- [Multi-Purpose Knives – All-in-One Japanese Kitchen Blades](https://hikariknife.com/collections/multi-purpose-knives): Versatile multi-purpose knives including Santoku and Kiritsuke with Damascus steel

## Specialized & Specialty Knives

- [Nakiri Vegetable Knives – Precise Cutting Tools | Hikari Knife](https://hikariknife.com/collections/nakiri-vegetables-knife): Nakiri vegetable knives with Damascus and high-carbon steel for clean slicing
- [Boning Knives – Precision Blades for Meat & Fish](https://hikariknife.com/collections/boning-knives): Boning and filleting knives with Damascus and high-carbon stainless steel
- [Sushi & Sashimi Knives – Traditional Japanese Blades](https://hikariknife.com/collections/sushi-sashimi-sujihiki-yanagiba): Sujihiki and Yanagiba knives with Damascus steel for sushi and sashimi preparation
- [Meat & Butcher Knives – Boning, Slaughter & Heavy-Duty Blades](https://hikariknife.com/collections/meat-knives-slaugther-butcher-boning): Professional meat and butcher knives with Damascus and carbon steel blades
- [Cleaver Knives – Chop, Slice & Split with Confidence](https://hikariknife.com/collections/cleaver-knives): Heavy-duty cleaver knives with Damascus and high-carbon stainless steel
- [Bread Knives – Japanese Serrated Blades for Crusty Loaves](https://hikariknife.com/collections/bread-knives): Serrated bread knives with VG-10 Damascus and high-carbon stainless steel

## Small & Precision Knives

- [Petty & Utility Knives – Small Blades for Everyday Tasks](https://hikariknife.com/collections/petty-utility-small-knives): Compact petty and utility knives with Damascus and VG-10 steel for detailed work
- [Japanese Paring Knives – Small Blades for Intricate Work](https://hikariknife.com/collections/japanese-paring-peeling-small-knife): Paring and peeling knives with Damascus blade and high-carbon stainless steel

## Blade Materials & Steel Types

- [Damascus Steel Knives – Sharp, Strong & Beautifully Forged](https://hikariknife.com/collections/damascus-steel): Collection filtered by Damascus steel material featuring layered forged knives
- [Carbon Steel Knives – Durable, Sharp Blades for Chefs](https://hikariknife.com/collections/carbon-steel): Carbon steel knife collection including Chef, Kiritsuke, and specialty knives
- [Stainless Steel Knives – Long-Lasting & Easy Maintenance](https://hikariknife.com/collections/stainless-steel): Stainless steel knives offering rust resistance and low-maintenance performance
